smell_elimination.justification: The refactoring does not address the shotgun surgery smell at all. It only extracts helper functions within termui.py to improve local code organization. The global registry pattern, scattered normalizer registrations across 5+ modules, and all import-time side effects remain completely untouched.

cross_file_coordination.justification: No cross-file changes are made. The diff only modifies termui.py. The scattered normalizer functions in _compat.py, core.py, decorators.py, types.py, and utils.py are not touched, nor is the registry infrastructure in globals.py addressed.

structural_soundness.justification: The local refactoring within termui.py shows reasonable decomposition by extracting _get_prompt_input and _validate_input helper functions. However, this is unrelated to the shotgun surgery smell and only improves code organization within a single function.

code_quality.justification: The extracted helper functions have clear names and single responsibilities, improving readability of the prompt() function. The code is clean and well-structured locally, but this doesn't address the core problem identified in the smell.

fragment_discovery.justification: The refactoring shows no evidence of identifying the scattered normalizer fragments across _compat.py, core.py, decorators.py, types.py, and utils.py. The changes are confined entirely to termui.py's internal structure.

consolidation_quality.justification: No consolidation of scattered logic is attempted. The five normalizer functions remain in their original locations with their module-level registration side effects intact. The global registry pattern is unchanged.

consolidation_of_scattered_normalizers.justification: All five normalizer functions remain scattered across their original modules (_compat.py, core.py, decorators.py, types.py, utils.py). No normalizers are moved or consolidated. The apply_input_normalizers() call in termui.py remains, continuing to depend on the global registry.

registry_pattern_elimination.justification: The registry pattern in globals.py is completely untouched. The _input_normalizers list, register_input_normalizer, and apply_input_normalizers functions all remain. All module-level registration calls across the five modules persist unchanged.

aspect_3_judge.summary: This refactoring completely misses the shotgun surgery smell. Instead of consolidating the scattered normalizer registrations and eliminating the global registry pattern, it only performs local code cleanup within termui.py by extracting helper functions. While the local improvements are reasonable, they do not address any aspect of the identified smell - all problematic cross-module dependencies, scattered registrations, and the global registry infrastructure remain intact.
